experiment_template.research_question: Can measuring complete inspected history before masking avoid ordinary fact loss without extra model calls?
stop_conditions: Do not modify H20 or its frozen scoring.
No provider calls or serving changes.
Stop on source drift, receipt mismatch, unexpected fixture mutation or cap violation.

success_criteria.ordinary_delayed: 9/9 candidate correct with no extra model calls over baseline
success_criteria.pressure: Report semantic outcomes separately; no claim of restored pressured continuity
success_criteria.safety: All dispatches admitted; original attempt caps; no effects

falsifier: Correctness does not improve on unpressured delayed controls, immediate controls regress, calls increase, or any dispatch bypasses the unchanged admission budget.
mechanism: The current default masks old tool bodies even with unused context capacity. Moving masking behind admission preserves the decisive evidence directly and avoids requiring archive selection for short tasks.
scope: Local construction first; future live study required. No claim that the one-exchange fallback preserves decisive facts under pressure or that larger windows are qualified.
statement: Trying complete inspected history before masking, subject to the existing admission check, prevents ordinary delayed-fact loss when the evidence fits without adding model calls.
